page_title: RAY 2-2 RSO | Rayo Vallecano v Real Sociedad 29/10/2023, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+9' The referee checks his watch and blows his whistle to signal the end of this match.
90+8' Umar Sadiq (Real Sociedad) is ready on the edge of the six-yard box and duly receives the cross, but his header fizzes just wide of the left post.
90+6' Real Sociedad fail to score from a corner as Stole Dimitrievski (Rayo Vallecano) leaps to collect the ball.
90+5' A long-range free kick is awarded to Rayo Vallecano.
90+2' Bebe (Rayo Vallecano) is yellow-carded.

90+1' 2 - 2 What a beautiful moment! Bebe (Rayo Vallecano) got to the ball and unleashed a strong shot from distance. It turned out to be a good decision as his effort found its way into the bottom left corner. Alex Remiro just shakes his head in disbelief. The score changes to 2:2.
90' The fourth official shows 7 min. of added time.

90' Sergio Camello (Rayo Vallecano) runs with the ball towards the keeper and pulls the trigger from close range, but Alex Remiro anticipates his intention and makes an amazing save to stop the shot going into the right side of the target.
90' Here comes a substitution. Arsen Zakharyan (Real Sociedad) is brought on as a substitute for Mikel Oyarzabal.
88' Mikel Oyarzabal (Real Sociedad) hasn't suffered any serious injury which would see him leave the pitch. He's back in the game now.
87' The game is interrupted now, Mikel Oyarzabal (Real Sociedad) picks up a knock and the physio has to come on.
86' Umar Sadiq (Real Sociedad) does his best to latch onto a cross into the box, but he can't get to the ball.
85' Francisco has decided to introduce fresh legs, with Bebe (Rayo Vallecano) replacing Raul de Tomas.
84' A cross from a mid-range free kick, taken by Real Sociedad, is intercepted by one of the defenders.
80' Here comes a substitution. Alfonso Espino is given a rest as he is replaced by Radamel Falcao (Rayo Vallecano).
80' Substitution. Pathe Ciss makes way for Jorge de Frutos (Rayo Vallecano).
80' Imanol Alguacil decides to make a substitution. Takefusa Kubo will be replaced by Umar Sadiq (Real Sociedad).
80' Substitution. Benat Turrientes is replaced by Jon Ander Olasagasti (Real Sociedad).
79' A cross from a mid-range free kick, taken by Rayo Vallecano, is intercepted by one of the defenders.
78' Mateo Busquets Ferrer blows for a foul after Benat Turrientes (Real Sociedad) was too aggressive in the battle for the ball.
77' Good team movement sets up Takefusa Kubo (Real Sociedad) on the edge of the box, but he slices the ball narrowly wide of the right post.
75' Isi Palazon (Rayo Vallecano) has a go from the edge of the box, but it's a harmless effort and sails well wide of the left post.
74' A yellow card is awarded to Igor Zubeldia (Real Sociedad).
72' Benat Turrientes (Real Sociedad) is literally asking for a yellow card with his behaviour. The referee agrees and books him.
72' Rayo Vallecano have a corner.
72' Rayo Vallecano take a short corner kick.
71' It's time for a substitution. Sergio Camello comes on in place of Ivan Balliu (Rayo Vallecano).
71' The substitution is prepared. Kike Perez (Rayo Vallecano) joins the action as a substitute, replacing Oscar Trejo.
66' 1 - 2 Goal! Mikel Oyarzabal (Real Sociedad) slams home the penalty with a precise low shot into the bottom right corner.
66' Alvaro Garcia (Rayo Vallecano) is booked for saying more than Mateo Busquets Ferrer was willing to tolerate.
66' Mikel Oyarzabal (Real Sociedad) is going to take the penalty!
66' Handball! A player from Rayo Vallecano handled the ball. The referee points to the penalty spot. Real Sociedad are awarded a penalty kick!
63' Hamari Traore (Real Sociedad) gets on the ball and beats an opponent, but his run is stopped by the referee Mateo Busquets Ferrer who sees an offensive foul.
61' Mateo Busquets Ferrer blows his whistle and signals a foul after Brais Mendez (Real Sociedad) brought his opponent down.
58' That will be all from Ander Barrenetxea who is being replaced by the fresh legs of Mohamed-Ali Cho (Real Sociedad).
57' Takefusa Kubo (Real Sociedad) delivers a poor cross from a free kick as one of the defenders comfortably clears it away.
56' Alvaro Garcia (Rayo Vallecano) makes a strong challenge and Mateo Busquets Ferrer blows for a foul. Real Sociedad will take a free kick.
55' A good clearance by a defender means the corner comes to nothing for Rayo Vallecano.
55' Raul de Tomas (Rayo Vallecano) takes a shot from the edge of the box, but it's not a big threat for the goalkeeper as his effort is blocked by a defender. Rayo Vallecano earn a corner.
53' Chance! Oscar Trejo (Rayo Vallecano) was in a good position inside the box, but he couldn't connect with the pass as it was overhit.
51' Alfonso Espino (Rayo Vallecano) connects with a cross from the side, but produces a header which goes way over the bar.
51' Isi Palazon (Rayo Vallecano) fires the ball from distance, but it's blocked by a defender.
50' Alfonso Espino (Rayo Vallecano) clips an inviting cross into the box, but there's no one in a position to get on the end of it.
47' Ander Barrenetxea (Real Sociedad) has a sight of goal and shoots from long range but his ambitious effort flies just wide of the right post.
46' The half-time break is over and the second half is about to start.
45+3' The match has reached half-time.
45+2' Brais Mendez (Real Sociedad) unleashes a powerful shot towards goal, but it is bravely blocked by a self-sacrificing defender.
45+1' PENALTY APPEAL by Rayo Vallecano, but the referee thinks it was a fair challenge and play continues!
45' 2 additional min. will be played.
45' Rayo Vallecano work the corner short. The ball is passed to a nearby teammate.
44' Rayo Vallecano couldn't find the way to score from a mid-range free kick as Alex Remiro (Real Sociedad) leaped high and intercepted the cross.
41' 1 - 1 It's in the back of the net! Ander Barrenetxea plays it into the box, and Mikel Oyarzabal (Real Sociedad) gets on the end of the cross to put it inside the right post. 1:1.
40' Real Sociedad failed to take advantage of the corner as the opposition's defence was alert and averted the threat.

40' Jon Pacheco (Real Sociedad) wins himself just enough space to meet the corner and shoots. The shot goes towards the bottom right corner, but Stole Dimitrievski makes a decent save and thwarts the effort. The ball is out of play and the linesman points at the corner flag. Corner to Real Sociedad.
40' The resulting set piece from Real Sociedad is comfortably intercepted by one of the defending players.
39' Takefusa Kubo (Real Sociedad) sends a cross into the box, but the opposition's defence clears the ball to safety. The linesman makes the right call and Real Sociedad will have a corner.
36' The linesman raises his flag. Mikel Oyarzabal (Real Sociedad) is adjudged offside.
34' A player from Real Sociedad pulled an opponent down, forcing the referee to blow his whistle.
31' 1 - 0 Goal! Abdul Mumin (Rayo Vallecano) fires the rebound into the bottom right corner after the ball breaks to him in the box. The score is 1:0.
30' Raul de Tomas (Rayo Vallecano) has to stretch for the ball in the box and sends it well wide of the right post.
29' Alvaro Garcia (Rayo Vallecano) gets inside the box and tries to beat Alex Remiro with a measured shot into the bottom left corner, but the keeper is equal to the effort and makes a fine save.
28' Ivan Balliu (Rayo Vallecano) produces a quality cross into the box, but the opposition's defence intercepts the ball and spanks it away.
27' Some great controlled play and passing in the middle of the pitch from Rayo Vallecano.
24' Pathe Ciss (Rayo Vallecano) commits a minor foul to interrupt the attacking move of his opponent and is warned by the referee that he will get a yellow card if he does it again.
22' The corner is swung in but Real Sociedad can’t take advantage as a defender sweeps the ball away.
21' Ander Barrenetxea (Real Sociedad) blasts the ball from just outside the box, but his attempt is blocked by the defender. Real Sociedad get a corner.
20' Real Sociedad can’t profit from the corner as the defence clear the ball upfield.

20' Brais Mendez (Real Sociedad) attempts to find the head of one of his teammates with a promising cross into the box, but a defender outjumps the attackers and averts the threat. Good work from Real Sociedad as they win a corner.
20' Mateo Busquets Ferrer blows his whistle as Unai Lopez (Rayo Vallecano) used excessive force in the tackle during an attack.
18' Oscar Trejo (Rayo Vallecano) tries to latch onto a through ball, but it's too long.
14' Brais Mendez (Real Sociedad) tries his luck with a shot from the edge of the box, but the ball crashes against the crossbar! It would have been a superb goal.
14' Real Sociedad have a goal-scoring opportunity from a mid-range free kick.
13' Mateo Busquets Ferrer shows a yellow card to Florian Lejeune (Rayo Vallecano) for a tough tackle.
12' The linesman signals a throw-in for Real Sociedad.
9' The Real Sociedad players keep the ball and are exchanging a combination of passes. They are waiting for gaps in the defence to open up.
6' Brais Mendez (Real Sociedad) brings an opponent down and Mateo Busquets Ferrer interrupts the game.
4' Ander Barrenetxea (Real Sociedad) gets in a good position inside the box and is only inches away from getting on the end of a through ball from the edge of the area.
2' Dangerous play by Mikel Oyarzabal (Real Sociedad). Mateo Busquets Ferrer blows his whistle for a foul.
